title: YOUR EXISTENCE
author: Misna Chanu
text:
In the most beautiful
Imagination of mind,
And in the deepest depth
Of my heart`s ocean,
In the silver soothing light
Of my soul`s sky,
And in the eyes of crimson dream
Where love resides,
In the tenderest poem
I have ever written
In love and loss,
And in the sweetest song
I have ever sung,
In the rhythm of
My heart beats and
Every drop of rain
Falling from the sky,
In the dew drops
Of morning meadow,
And in the colors
Of autumn hills,
In the freshness
Of spring garden,
And in the warmth
Of summer days,
In the flames of
Winter fire,
And in the details of every dream
Dreamt in love,
In the feathery touch
Of memories
That denied to be faded with time
And on the peripheral
Of my existence,
Love carves
Your existence, my beloved!
stanzas: And in the eyes of crimson dream
And in the details of every dream
That denied to be faded with time
